[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Open Pomodoro names follow their tasks' types[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Every live Task Link under one of today's open, typed Pomodoros has[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]a task type that the entry's name contains, and the name holds no [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]type that none of its links carry. Gestures keep this true at their[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]shared write paths, the close settles each finished session's name,[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]and `bob task reconcile` is the safety net. It repairs open names [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]in both directions and never writes a `\[type::]` field.[/#D7D7AF]
